newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast products eased amid quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast products eased amid quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. West Coast product prices fell with NYMEX early Monday, with little trade and few deals expected before the Christmas holiday, traders said.
NYMEX January gasoline fell 1.29 cents to 68.90 cents a gallon in late New York trade. Heating oil dropped 2.07 cents a gallon to 71.08 cents.
Bids for Los Angeles unleaded CARB gasoline fell one cent to 74 cents a gallon, while offers eased 0.50 cent to 75 cents.
CARB diesel dropped a cent to 73/74 cents a gallon, and "EPA" quality diesel eased a half cent to 71/72 cents, traders said.
